entities.name: Hernán Cortés
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Spanish conquistador (1485–1547) who led the expedition that caused the fall of the Aztec Empire in 1521. With fewer than 600 soldiers, indigenous allies, and smallpox as an unwitting weapon, he conquered Tenochtitlan (present-day Mexico City) — one of the largest cities in the world — and claimed Mexico for the Spanish Crown.
